findings.summary: grep -c "PENDING" graphs/AnyMemo/graph_def.py == 7, but the brief (item a end and STEP 8 item 7) requires 0.
findings.detail: The 7 hits are all the pre-existing C3_LIB_PENDING constant at graph_def.py:2080 and its six evidence uses at :2246, :2248, :2264, :2266, :2282, :2284 (the androidx ViewDataBinding 'pending-bindings pass' text). STEP 1's own round-1 placeholder markers are correctly gone (grep -c 'PENDING (round 1)' == 0 and grep -c 'round 1 PENDING' == 0), so the gate's intent is met, but the literal gate the binding spec states is not satisfied. Confirmed pre-existing: scratch/graph_def_before_round2.py has 9 PENDING (these 7 plus the 2 round-1 markers STEP 1 removed).
findings.fix: Either record an explicit relaxation of the grep==0 gate for the pre-existing C3_LIB_PENDING token in the binding spec, or (if the rename is authorized) rename C3_LIB_PENDING at graph_def.py:2080 and reword its six uses (:2246, :2248, :2264, :2266, :2282, :2284) so the literal count reaches 0; then rebuild (expect errors 0 / warnings 0) and re-run STEP 8.
